message.content: {"basis": "The dashboard title explicitly scopes the plotted data to a named subset: “High-Response Age Groups: Ad Spend vs Sales.” The chart displays five specific age groups (18–24 through 55–64) and shows a positive descriptive association between advertising spend and sales. However, the visual evidence does not define what “broader targeting” entails, nor does it provide ROI, causal, or full-audience comparison data. Because the approval standard for “broader targeting” is not established by the visible dashboard evidence, the available data is insufficient to justify approval or outright rejection.", "option_label": "Hold and request full-data analysis"}
